subject: Request: sandbox cushion + two-week pilot extension (adapter freeze)

Subject: Blocker: schema adapter regression — asking for pilot cushion and timeline wiggle

Hi Sofia,

Quick note from our side — our integration team ran into an unexpected schema change in our payments adapter this morning that broke the connector tests. We spent the day diagnosing; it looks like the vendor SDK introduced a field rename and we need to update our mapping layer.

This stalls our demo work and puts us ~5 business days behind. The current sandbox credit is close to depletion because our QA team retried a bunch of failed jobs. Can Redwood provide a small one-time sandbox credit bump and a two-week extension on the pilot window so we can finish the fix and run the full demo for the PM/Eng stakeholders?

Numbers: we estimate ~35k tokens to finish the rework and another ~15k for regression testing (so ~50k tokens total).

I attached a short error log and one failing request payload for context.

Appreciate any help — we love how fast Redwood runs in our staging tests and want to keep momentum.

Thanks,
Oliver Reed
Integrations Lead
FluxPay
